facts.fact: The 2024 finance law (Loi n° 2023-1000 of 18 December 2023) appropriates FCFA 17,935,498,592 to programme 22126 'Economie numérique et poste' of the Ministry of Digital Transition and Digitalisation, a recurrent line met from the general domestic budget.
facts.system: Programme 22126 Economie numérique et poste, Ministry of Digital Transition and Digitalisation, FY2024 budget

facts.fact: The 2024 settlement law records FCFA 23,434,278,284 spent in 2024 on programme 22126 of the Ministry's own budget line, 99.99% of a revised FCFA 23,437,413,869 and 130.66% of the FCFA 17,935,498,592 voted; the ministry's line only, no fund collections given.
facts.system: Programme 22126 Economie numérique et poste, Ministry of Digital Transition and Digitalisation, FY2024 outturn
